newsitem.title: USA: Regency to acquire Branch for $213 million.
newsitem.headline: Regency to acquire Branch for $213 million.

text.p: Regency Realty Corp. said Monday it has agreed to acquire Branch Properties LP, which owns neighbourhood shopping centres in Atlanta, in a deal worth about $301.6 million.
The acquisition includes 18 existing shopping centres, eight others that are being developed or redeveloped, and management contracts.
Including the managed properties, Regency will operate about 40 shopping centres in the Atlanta market after the deal closes.

Regency, based in Jacksonville, Fla., said it will offer Branch 3,533,000 new partnership units and shares convertible into common stock worth $190 million, and assume $111.6 million in Branch's debt.
Over the next three years Branch has the right to earn an additional $23.3 million, payable in 1,053,000 partnership units, the company said.
Regency's stock rose 37.5 cents to $26.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
